# September 11th Documents Toolkit

Independent research tools for New York City’s September 11th Document Portal. Not an official City site. Not legal or medical advice.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://pranava0x0.github.io/sept11documents-mcp/): City records, release commitments, dated obligations, and saved catalog captures.
- [The MCP](https://pranava0x0.github.io/sept11documents-mcp/toolkit.html): ten read-only tools, resources, prompts, and recorded calls.
- [Examples](https://pranava0x0.github.io/sept11documents-mcp/examples.html): ten browser demos using local, allowlisted data. They show the tool route and its limits.
- [Records](https://pranava0x0.github.io/sept11documents-mcp/records.html): located records with cited quotations and Bates pages.
- [Community support](https://pranava0x0.github.io/sept11documents-mcp/community.html): direct links to organizations serving the 9/11 community.

## MCP

The server is local and read-only. `portal_search` is the only tool that contacts the City and requires opt-in. Other tools use saved catalog metadata, captured page text, or allowlisted JSON.

Tools: `portal_search`, `catalog_search`, `portal_get_document`, `portal_get_page_text`, `portal_catalog_stats`, `portal_browse`, `portal_changes_since`, `citations_verify`, `doi_milestones`, `budget_lookup`.

Use `citations_verify` before repeating a quote. A `found` result locates text; it is not a legal, medical, or factual conclusion beyond that text.

## Data limits

Catalog totals and changes describe saved captures. A missing record in a later capture is not proof of removal or withholding. Announced amounts are not summed and are not transaction records. Current service rules and eligibility belong to the organizations and official programs linked on the site.
